review.review: The recording ends with a living hero at 3 HP, not an observed death. Decision 3039 (log lines 9063–9065) reports exhausted exploration without a reachable exit; four wall searches and the final scry did not expose an admitted continuation. An earlier, repairable contributor is stale caster memory: decision 2980 (lines 8895–8897) attacks the adjacent DM-100, advances one turn, gains six XP across a level-up, and appends a second identical defeat message after retained pickup messages. tools/combat_observation.py:248–261 used text-set novelty, so it missed that new receipt. Decision 2986 (line 8913) then explicitly flees an unseen remembered caster at 1046 through decision 2996, followed by retracing the route toward the mandatory iron key. The proposed narrow correction recognizes a replacement defeat entry using its changed order relative to a unique retained pickup message; it retires only matching caster memory and its matching plan. It does not infer a kill from disappearance or XP alone, authorize movement, or waive key pickup. A reduced public-evidence regression failed on the original policy and passes with the correction; the full suite passes 2,284 tests with four skips. An isolated exact receipt-pair probe also retires the matching memory, without selecting or dispatching a subsequent action. This does not establish that the extra travel caused terminal exhaustion, that another route would survive, or that the missing exit would be found. Separately, decision 1997 (lines 6085–6088) records an unfinished piranha chest blocking descent. Recovery actually descends at decision 2039 (lines 6304–6306), without collection credit; that is not a pool-planner repair. Offline bookkeeping reconstruction validated selected inputs 0–1996 against this played source and the saved public observations; it is not originally recorded memory. At decision 1997, isolated copies have no deferred supply controller or active stash/probe, but none of 16 currently visible safe testing banks admits an actionable protected pool journey. Preparation declines. No changed decision was followed with fabricated observations.
review.learnings: A repeated defeat message can be newly appended even when its text is already on screen. Use a conservative ordered receipt witness to retire only the matching remembered caster; disappearance alone remains insufficient. Keep mandatory key collection and terminal planner exhaustion intact. Recovered pool abandonment and terminal missing-exit exhaustion remain separate unresolved planning failures.
